# Pico flashing library

The updater vendors the MIT-licensed PICOBOOT JavaScript modules from
[picoflash v0.1.5](https://github.com/piersfinlayson/picoflash/tree/v0.1.5)
at commit 9f647ee9c46a21f4d1efc2d272f19be6cd309d1d. See the license alongside
the unmodified modules. The updater supports the RP2040 Tool Kit images.
